verdict.rationale: Copilot's own privacy FAQ documents a user opt-out from having conversation activity used for model training, and the ability to delete conversation history. That covers one slice of usage-data control, but no general telemetry or diagnostic tracking opt-out is documented. Missing for 10: a documented opt-out for telemetry and diagnostic data, a usage-tracking or analytics opt-out beyond model training, coverage across Microsoft 365-integrated Copilot surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: You can opt out of use of your conversation activity for model training at any time.
Yes, you can delete individual conversations or your entire conversation history at any time.
